title: Importance of Faith in Afterlife
summary: Faith is the greatest blessing leading to paradise, unlike worldly luxuries.
translation: All the blessings given to us by Allah, the greatest and most important blessing is faith. It is only due to faith that we can enter paradise. Without faith, we will face an eternal and extremely dangerous abode called hell, a very painful place. Thus, even if a person lives a prosperous life with health, joy, and all conveniences—good clothes, a nice car, a good house, excellent staff, and all high-grade things, if his end is not with faith, he will end up in a world that everyone should seek refuge from, known as hell. Conversely, if a person remains homeless or poorly dressed, without even basic food, but believes in worshiping Allah, the Essence of Allah, and the Prophethood of the Messenger Muhammad (peace be upon him), despite any sins, he will ultimately be rewarded with paradise. This paradise is such a magnificent palace, a splendid garden, and a marvelous place that no ear has heard, no eye has seen, nor has any mind imagined. Therefore, one should remember to value the blessing of faith given by Allah. When something is not valued, it is taken away. Hence, express gratitude to Allah for being a person of faith and strictly follow His commands. The Quran states, 'And for whoever of you turns back from their religion and dies as a disbeliever, their deeds will be of no avail in this world and the Hereafter.' Therefore, whoever turns away from their religion, does not value their faith, and denies both the foundational and subsidiary aspects of their religion, whether practically or by belief, will have their good deeds nullified, and hell will be their ultimate abode. Thus, one should always remember that faith is a great blessing among all blessings of Allah, and it should be valued, adhering strictly to its obligatory acts. Pray to Allah and ask Him to keep us steadfast on this path of guidance until the very end.
